text:
Ethan: FYI billing flagged a canary where fallback paths doubled token counts for some customers. need a clear policy.
Priya: we currently tag the responder as 'served' which can double-count when fallback appends content. agree this is bad.
Lena: UI perspective: ops wants to see 'grace remaining' on the rollout card and a timeline of when grace was consumed.
Marco: API proposal: add rollout.charge_policy = enum(full|grace|none) + grace_tokens + grace_window. default=full.
Ethan: grace semantics: if set to 'grace', first N tokens in window are not billed. sounds good for canaries but could be abused.
Priya: add cooldown and immutable audit events on changes to grace. audit event should include actor, reason, rollout_id, tokens_granted, ts. redact any request/model payloads.
Lena: small mock: "Degrade 1.8% · Grace left: 2.4k" on rollout card; click opens history and audit trail.
Marco: routing change: router emits a tiny decision tag: {decision: primary|fallback|quarantine, reason: timeout|oom|model_error, policy}. feature-flagged and off by default.
Priya: traces: default off. adaptive sampling: baseline 0.1% -> if fallback_rate(route)>1% bump to 10% for 15m then decay by 0.5. per-route+org optional.
Ethan: Finance needs estimate of incremental cost if 1% of routes go high sampling. include in PR.
Lena: operator override: Pause fallbacks / Resume. require justification modal, create audit event, only rollout-operators group can do it.
Marco: invoice export: include grace budget lines so Finance reconciles free tokens per rollout.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: created PLAT-4823 "rollout grace + decision_trace + sampling" scheduled for staging.
Ethan: next steps: Marco to add API fields + migration notes; Priya to author audit schema; Lena to post mocks; sync Monday 9am.
Priya: note: scrub PII & model outputs from any telemetry.
Ethan: agreed. thanks all.
